title: Cell window state space
statement: For the types and phase spaces used by the window procedure, define its cell window state space as the disjoint union of the recursive half-window states, a unit state or one of two indexed states, another copy of the half-window states, two seek-phase state spaces, and a scan phase carrying a unit value.
caveat: The abbreviation depends on auxiliary state spaces not defined in the supplied definitions, so this describes its sum structure rather than the operational meaning of every component.
